test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is a bacterial disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leprosy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main cause of leprosy is Mycobacterium.
 
• Leprosy, also known as Hansen's disease, is caused by slow-growing bacteria called Mycobacterium leprae.
 
• It is an infectious disease that causes nerve damage in the skin, arms, and legs and also causes skin sores.
 
• The main symptoms include disfiguring skin sores, lumps, or bumps.
